blocks.text: Daybud joins the opening of a day with the opening of a small made flower. A new interval does not erase what a pet has lived through; it offers a modest practical aid within continuing care.
A dark violet flower-bud mechanism with mismatched ivory petals and an aqua coiled center.
One-shot use: The petals unfold fully and the center rises, bursting into a large ring of droplets over the open flower. The game performs the final fade.
14 silver. Exhaustion severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Energy +8; Happiness +5. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 80501184-a1ab-4ecb-9670-b121fb4a3081; animation c8c4eb59-8efc-423a-8c8e-b093f0ac02ce. Reduced motion holds a still.
